queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_frpm_records FROM frpm LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_satscores_records FROM satscores LIMIT 1
SELECT f.CDSCode, s.cds, s.NumGE1500, s.NumTstTakr, CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr as ratio FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds LIMIT 10

SELECT f.CDSCode, CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" as free_ratio FROM frpm f WHERE f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10

SELECT MAX(CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") as max_ratio FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3 AND f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
